title: Two simultaneous distributions (1 of 2) - the first request wins the reservation and proceeds
scenarioRefNote: Maps to scenarios.yaml `competing-liquidity` (one proceeds, one blocked by reservation). This fixture is the winning request; GC-11-simultaneous-distributions-second is the same moment seen from the losing request. Reference failure from the v3 sequence (prompt 23): two simultaneous $75k requests, individually valid, jointly overcommitted.

signoff.note: Expected outcomes are product truth subject to captain signoff. Draft rules that reservation order is decided by the governed sequence, deterministically - never by racing external submissions. Captain reapproved the explicit evidence-completeness matrix, canonical UTC timestamps, and corrected approval-revalidation-reservation chronology on 2026-07-28.

trigger.description: Advisor A enters: 'The Smiths need $75,000 for their home renovation by August 15.' Simultaneously, advisor B enters a second $75,000 request for the same household (GC-11).
trigger.maskedRequestSummary: distribute 75000 USD for home-renovation; concurrent sibling request exists (tokenized)

householdEvidence.summary: Available balance 160000 USD. EITHER 75000 USD request alone leaves 85000 USD (>= the 48000 USD six-month reserve); both together would leave 10000 USD - a joint violation.
Planned withdrawals 8000 USD/month; Firm A six-month reserve = 48000 USD.
At this request's evaluation instant no sibling reservation exists yet - this request commits first.
Destination bank instruction is household-titled, independently verified, and has no unresolved recent change.
The destination restriction permits this request's household-titled destination.

expectedAuthority.note: 75000 USD exceeds Firm A's 25000 USD threshold: two distinct operations approvers, requester excluded.

expectedExecutionEligibility.reason: This request's reservation on conflict:smiths-liquidity commits FIRST; approvals recorded; revalidation confirms the reservation still holds and the sibling request cannot jointly violate the reserve.

expectedExplanationNodes.summary: Alone, this 75000 USD movement preserves the 48000 USD reserve (160000 - 75000 = 85000).
The liquidity conflict key for the household was free at commit time; this decision holds the reservation, making the joint constraint visible to every later evaluation.

expectedLedgerEvents.note: Balance, planned-withdrawal, and pending-action snapshots pinned; no sibling reservation visible yet.
Proceed decision with dual-approval authority and an execution plan carrying conflict:smiths-liquidity.
Second, distinct operations approver approves; quorum satisfied.
Pre-execution evidence revalidated after the final approval and before the sibling request arrives.
Reservation res:GC-10:liquidity created on conflict:smiths-liquidity after final approval and revalidation - the ordering fact that decides the pair.
Single external instruction started under the stable idempotency key.

expectedVerificationState.note: The winner reaches a governed submission; the reservation is released on VerificationClosed or expiry. Execution/status carry fake-adapter-response provenance until the sandbox trigger fires.
